intent: Keep only biallelic SNPs with a minor allele frequency of at least 5% and write them to a new VCF; the functional annotation in the INFO column must survive for the next step.
silent_error: vcftools --recode writes the INFO column as '.' unless --recode-INFO-all (or --recode-INFO <key>) is given. The filtered VCF still declares the INFO keys in its header and has the right sites and genotypes, but DP, AF and the ANN effect/gene annotation are gone from every record. Nothing is reported, exit 0. Documented in the vcftools manual (--recode, --recode-INFO-all).
